research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: FullStory is researching methods for capturing and processing interactions with user interfaces of native applications, focusing on evaluating user sessions to understand behavior. Their work includes evaluating interactions with a user interface by identifying mutation events that specify changes to the UI structure. Additionally, they are developing tools for network latency detection by analyzing network request data from client devices. These areas reflect efforts in user interaction analysis and performance monitoring.

overview_description.description:
FullStory is a customer experience data app that captures customer experience data in one platform. Its tiny script unlocks pixel-perfect session playback, automatic insights, funnel analytics, and robust search and segmentation empowering everyone in an organization to help build an online experience for customers.

The company was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.

product.description: A data activation product that delivers Fullstory behavioral data to other systems for personalization, warehouse analysis, and operational use.

product.name: Fullstory Workforce
product.description: An employee experience and workflow intelligence product that analyzes internal processes to identify operational friction and improve employee support.

product.name: Fullcapture
product.description: A privacy-focused behavioral data capture capability that records user interactions across digital experiences for analysis, activation, and AI-assisted insights.

product.name: StoryAI
product.description: An AI-powered behavioral intelligence product that answers business questions and generates insights from Fullstory interaction data.
